description: Figure 7 is a line plot comparing different query selection strategies for training a DPR retriever. The x-axis, labeled "S", represents the number of selected queries for document expansion, ranging from 1 to 10 on a linear scale with tick marks at every integer. The y-axis, labeled "MRR@10", measures the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10, ranging from approximately 34.0 to 36.5 on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot displays six distinct lines, each representing a different strategy, with solid lines for corpus expansion and dotted lines for the typical representation, as explained in the caption. The red solid line, representing corpus expansion with the curriculum strategy, starts at an MRR@10 of 35.66 at S=1 and increases linearly to approximately 36.5 at S=10. The red dotted line, representing the typical representation with the curriculum strategy, starts at 35.66 at S=1 and remains relatively flat, ending at approximately 35.7 at S=10. The blue solid line, for corpus expansion with the top-1 query, begins at 35.15 at S=1 and rises to about 36.0 at S=10. The blue dotted line, for the typical representation with the top-1 query, starts at 35.15 and stays nearly constant around 35.2. The green solid line, for corpus expansion with the bottom-1 query, starts at 34.26 at S=1 and increases to roughly 35.5 at S=10. The green dotted line, for the typical representation with the bottom-1 query, begins at 34.26 and remains flat at approximately 34.3. The plot visually demonstrates that for all strategies, the typical representation (dotted lines) consistently outperforms its corpus expansion counterpart (solid lines) at S=1, and that performance generally improves with increasing S for corpus expansion methods.
